import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive analysis
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Top Left: Total Sales by Product
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars1 = ax1.barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors[:len(product_sales)])
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
# Add value labels
for bar, val in zip(bars1, product_sales.values):
    ax1.text(val + 50, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'${val:,.0f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Top Right: Sales by Customer Age Group
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum()
# Order age groups logically
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = age_sales.reindex(age_order)
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors[:len(age_sales)],
                                    explode=[0.02]*len(age_sales), startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Sales Distribution by Customer Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
plt.setp(autotexts, size=9, weight='bold')

# 3. Bottom Left: Average Transaction by Size and Payment Method
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
size_payment = df.groupby(['size', 'payment_method'])['total'].mean().unstack()
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_payment = size_payment.reindex(size_order)
size_payment.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=colors[:len(size_payment.columns)], width=0.7)
ax3.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Transaction ($)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Average Transaction by Size & Payment Method', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Payment Method', loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
ax3.set_xticklabels(ax3.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax3.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=10)

# 4. Bottom Right: Daily Sales Trend
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
daily_sales = df.groupby('date')['total'].sum().reset_index()
ax4.plot(daily_sales['date'], daily_sales['total'], color=colors[0], linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.7)
# Add rolling average
rolling_avg = daily_sales['total'].rolling(window=7).mean()
ax4.plot(daily_sales['date'], rolling_avg, color=colors[3], linewidth=2.5, 
         label='7-day Rolling Avg', linestyle='--')
ax4.fill_between(daily_sales['date'], daily_sales['total'], alpha=0.3, color=colors[0])
ax4.set_xlabel('Date', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Daily Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Daily Sales Trend with 7-Day Moving Average', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=9)
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45, labelsize=9)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
